item.title: Context7
item.description: Context7 resolves a library name (like “Next.js” or “shadcn/ui”) to a version-specific ID, then pulls current documentation and code snippets straight from the source into an agent’s prompt. It works with no signup for basic usage, with a free API key available for higher rate limits.
